about: Supporting log of the products file: field sources, missing-value reasons, store and fulfillment checks against the site's own data, offer details, the store-assortment decision apart from the current offer, the UPC outcome of each product's own page, and the collection segment that observed each product. 'observation_kind' is 'fresh' (observed by this run; 'observation.earlier_segment' is true when an earlier segment of this resumed run observed it) or 'carried_forward' (not observed by this run: an earlier run's verified observation kept unchanged, with its own crawl date, in 'historical'). A replay's products are 'replayed': observed by the replay's source run (replay_of), read again from its stored pages by this run's code; never fresh observations. A replay's UPC outcomes name the run that requested each product page (upc_detail.observed_by_run) and the replay (upc_detail.read_again_by_run).
